note: Site understanding settings (S6). No MUTCD value lives here. Every entry has a source or is tagged CALIBRATION_PENDING.

evidence_max_words.source: S0 prompt tuning proposal P1, approved S6 Q3 B

safety_critical_fields.source: owner decision, S6 session 1 (Q7/Q8): AI plus OSM must agree, otherwise UNKNOWN

edge_pixel_error_px_cross_section.note: D-38 example: one pixel of error on each edge. Starting value for the deterministic cross-section. S6 STOP 2: accepted as the starting model.

edge_pixel_error_px_ai_marks.note: Derived from the nine recorded spike widths (claude-opus-5-5, pre-tuning prompt, 3 sites x 3 repetitions): at the spike scale (about 0.44 m per pixel) all nine traveled-way widths fall inside the band (3.0 px x 2 edges) around their site's median, which 1.0 px and 2.0 px do not achieve. NOT calibrated against drawings (Q20). gpt-5.6-sol has not run; its marks may differ. Recorded as a test (test_ai_mark_error_evidence).

edges_per_width.source: geometry: a width is bounded by two edges, each with the pixel error

interval_includes_section_spread.source: S6 Q9 A: interval = width +/- (edge error x mpp_sent x edges) plus the section spread

work_vehicle_width_in.source: 23 CFR 658.15 (maximum vehicle width 102 in); owner decision S6 session 1
work_vehicle_width_in.note: Used only when no vehicle is measured in the image. Optional: a caller may leave it out of the footprint.

work_space_depth_ft.note: No source. Asked per job (asked-if-needed work_type and size, S11); stays UNKNOWN until the SME supplies it.

work_space_clearance_ft.note: Clearance between the work space and the near face of the devices. No source. Asked per job.

crops.note: Crop engine (S6 commit 5, Q15 A). The crop centre is always the work reference (the image centre), computed by code; the model never chooses a crop. Values for the lane features are READ from config/pipeline_config.json (crops.min_px_per_lane, fusion.lane_width_plausible_m, crops.primary_zoom, crops.image_px, sharpness.uniform_max_std), not copied here.

lane_group.source: S6 Q15 A: the existing crops.min_px_per_lane applies to the lane features
lane_group.feature_m: the low end of fusion.lane_width_plausible_m (the narrowest plausible lane: the conservative case)

pending_features.note: No pixels-per-feature value exists for these. Until one is calibrated they are never judged sufficient, so a higher-zoom view (up to the zoom ceiling) is always requested when one of them is needed. May cost extra Azure Maps requests.

zoom_ceiling.source: config/pipeline_config.json crops.primary_zoom (the documented maximum of the microsoft.imagery tileset); no higher zoom is ever requested, so the upsampling sharpness check (sharpness.min_detail_gain_ratio) is not needed here

osm.note: OSM rules of S6 (owner plan 2026-10-31). Every distance and angle is CALIBRATION_PENDING: a starting value that is used and flagged, not a calibrated one. A missing lanes or shoulder tag is no information; a missing oneway tag counts as not one-way at lower confidence.

query_radius_m.note: radius of the one bounded Overpass query around the work point; must not exceed config/data_sources.json osm_overpass.query_limits.max_radius_m

highway_classes.source: OSM wiki Key:highway (road classes a vehicle can use); service included for driveways and parking aisles so they can be told apart, never chosen over a named road

max_way_distance_m.note: a way farther than this from the work point is not the road of the job

divided_max_separation_m.note: largest distance between the two carriageways of a divided road

divided_parallel_tolerance_deg.note: largest angle (mod 180) between the two ways for them to count as parallel

divided_require_same_name_or_ref.note: the opposite way must share the name or the ref of the chosen way

bearing.note: Bearing cross-check (owner plan 2026-10-31). The road direction read from the AI's edge and lane-line marks (code, modulo 180) must match the nearest OSM way within the tolerance. Evidence: the nine gpt-5.6-sol calls gave E Second St 0, 90, 91 degrees and Colorado 28, 140, 41 degrees; the Claude calls 90,90,90 and 36,39,39.

tolerance_deg.note: largest angle (mod 180) between the mark bearing and an OSM way bearing for them to be the same road

which_road_distance_m.note: OSM ways (service ways excluded) within this distance of the work point are the candidates for the road of the job; if they differ in bearing by more than the tolerance the SME is asked which road
